name: Zhongtian Service Co., Ltd.
summary: Bus Online Co., Ltd., headquartered in Jiashan, China, is actively involved in the creation, development, production, and sale of communication-related electro-acoustic devices and their constituent parts across the Chinese market. Their product line notably features miniature receivers and speakers. The company, which was founded in 2000, previously operated as Zhejiang Newjialian Electronic Co., Ltd. before officially adopting the name Bus Online Co., Ltd. in January 2016.
